entities.summary: Mario Alberto Avilés, C.O. is a Mexican-born American Catholic prelate who has been the Bishop of Corpus Christi since 2026. He served as an auxiliary bishop for the Diocese of Brownsville from 2018 to 2025. He is a member of the Oratorians. Mario Alberto Avilés was a religious figures from Mexico City (b. 1969-09-16, Mexico City). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
